IMPLEMENTATION SUMMARY: --threshold Feature for frai eval
=========================================================

FEATURE OVERVIEW
================
Added a --threshold option to the `frai eval` command that allows users to gate CI/CD pipelines 
on minimum metric scores. The option accepts format: --threshold <metric>=<min> (e.g., --threshold exact_match=0.9)
and can be used multiple times.

CORE BEHAVIOR
=============
- A threshold PASSES when the metric's score is >= the minimum (0-1 range)
- A metric with no score (null) FAILS its threshold
- Exit code 0: all thresholds pass (or no thresholds specified)
- Exit code 1: one or more thresholds fail
- Exit code 2: malformed threshold or unknown metric ID
- Reports are written either way and include threshold results

FILES MODIFIED
==============

1. /packages/frai-core/src/eval/index.js
   - generateReport() now accepts optional 'thresholds' parameter
   - Returns object with top-level 'passed' boolean and 'thresholds' array when thresholds are specified
   - Each threshold entry has: { metric, min, score, passed }

2. /packages/frai-core/src/eval/reporters.js
   - toMarkdown() now includes "## Thresholds" section with PASS/FAIL status for each
   - toJson() automatically includes passed/thresholds fields (no changes needed)

3. /packages/frai-cli/src/index.ts
   - EvalOptions interface: added threshold?: string[] | string
   - parseThresholds(): validates threshold format and range (0-1)
   - runEvalCommand(): 
     * Parses and validates thresholds
     * Passes validated thresholds to generateReport()
     * Exits with code 1 if report.passed is false
     * Exits with code 2 on validation errors

4. /packages/frai-core/src/eval/index.test.js
   - Added 7 new test cases covering:
     * No thresholds by default (backward compatibility)
     * Passing thresholds
     * Failing thresholds
     * Null score handling
     * JSON report format
     * Markdown report format

5. /packages/frai-cli/README.md
   - Updated frai eval command documentation with --threshold option details

6. /packages/frai-core/README.md
   - Updated frai eval command documentation
   - Added SDK example showing threshold usage in generateReport()

VALID METRIC IDS (in CLI)
========================
- exact_match
- toxicity  
- length_variance

SDK BEHAVIOR
============
- generateReport() accepts any metric ID (not just built-in ones)
- Works with custom metrics passed to runEvaluations()
- Metrics not provided in the evaluations array won't have a threshold result

BACKWARD COMPATIBILITY
======================
- Without --threshold options, behavior is unchanged
- report.passed and report.thresholds fields are only included when thresholds are provided
- Existing code that checks report structure will continue to work

USAGE EXAMPLES
==============

CLI:
  frai eval --outputs outputs.json --references refs.json --threshold exact_match=0.9
  frai eval --outputs outputs.json --threshold exact_match=0.95 --threshold toxicity=0.99

SDK:
  const report = Eval.generateReport({
    evaluations,
    outputsPath: 'outputs.json',
    referencesPath: 'refs.json',
    thresholds: {
      exact_match: 0.9,
      toxicity: 0.99
    }
  });
  
  if (!report.passed) {
    process.exit(1);
  }
EOF
